A '''tight-beam beacon''' was a communications beacon. [[StarForge Station]] used a tight-beam beacon to guide incoming [[Starship/Legends|starships]] through the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]] to its hidden location.<ref name="PW">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Preparing for War}}</ref>
